data.title: 阿尼斯 · 夏日明黄碎花吊带裙与冰镇柠檬水
data.description: 初夏微风拂过的热闹露天集市旁，阿尼斯身穿明黄色碎花吊带连衣裙。她单手递出一杯凝结着清凉水珠的柠檬冷饮，在斑驳树影下冲你元气满溢地展颜欢笑，裙摆随微风轻轻拂动。
data.location: 前哨基地遮阳树荫集市
data.action: 手递冰柠檬水，露出元气自信的灿烂笑颜
data.lighting: 树荫斑驳的明亮夏日阳光
data.promptProse: Holding out a condensation-beaded cup of iced lemonade under the park trees, she wears a radiant yellow floral sundress with delicate thin straps. Dappled afternoon light accents her bare shoulders and lively, cheerful grin.
data.animaCaption: She offers a cold cup of lemonade under the dappled sunlight in her yellow sundress.
